[SWS_SM_00624] ActionListItem - Sleep
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00001, RS_SM_00005
⌈
When a
Sleep ActionListItem
is found in the
ActionLists
,
StateMachine
shall delay processing next
ActionListItem
on the
ActionLists
for the config-
ured time.
⌋
Please note that
Sleep ActionListItem
will not "block" processing incoming trig-
gers meanwhile. This means that a call to
RequestTransition
, an error Notifi-
cation ([SWS_SM_00601]) or a change in a
NmNetworkHandle
([SWS_SM_00620]
/ [SWS_SM_00621]) for the sleeping the
StateMachine State
might cause a
StateMachine State
change (depending on configuration).
